ValidationRule.description: The Account Name and FEIN fields should be locked to all users except those with the Account_Name_and_FEIN_Edit_Permission custom permission when there is at least one Asset record associated with the Account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Account_Name_and_FEIN_Locked__c , NOT( $Permission.Account_Name_and_FEIN_Edit_Permission ), OR(ISCHANGED( Name ), ISCHANGED( NSP_FEIN__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Because there is an Asset related to this Account, you do not have permission to change the Account Name or FEIN.
